title: Switched Pinnacle (pinnapi) off
body: Pinnacle (pinnapi) was not accepted: it was not accepted on 3 fresh runners in a row (last: Refused (HTTP 403): this key is not accepted.). The engine restarted it and tried 3 fresh GitHub runner(s). It is OFF now and stays off until you look at it: check its key and plan, then switch it back on in Settings › APIs (the ladder starts again).
